alerts.summary: RELEVANCE is no longer a sort key on these connections; a query that sorts by it must choose another key (Shopify says it acted as an ID sort).
alerts.quote: `RELEVANCE` will no longer be included in connection sort options by default as of `2025-04` API versions. This will eliminate cases where the option offered no unique behavior, and acted as a basic `ID` sort.

alerts.summary: Legacy shipping mode profiles are discontinued; their fields return static data and their mutations are no-ops, and the schema removes them in 2026-04. Remove the selections and arguments.
alerts.quote: Support for legacy mode profiles in shipping has been discontinued.

alerts.summary: inventorySetScheduledChanges is removed in 2026-07 with no replacement; code that schedules inventory changes needs another approach, such as immediate inventoryAdjustQuantities calls.
alerts.quote: mutation will be removed from the GraphQL Admin API in version `2026-07`. This mutation has no replacement, so any apps currently using it should stop relying on it to avoid disruptions.

alerts.summary: DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule is removed in 2026-10; select discountTitle and discountCode on the warning instead. The replacement is two scalar fields, not the PriceRule object.
alerts.quote: Update any query that reads `priceRule` from this warning to select `discountTitle` and `discountCode` instead.

alerts.summary: Removing DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule removes the PriceRule object and its related types from the 2026-10 schema; fragments and variables that name them stop validating.
alerts.quote: As a result, removing `priceRule` also removes the `PriceRule` object and its related types from the public schema in `2026-10` and later.

alerts.summary: FulfillmentService.permitsSkuSharing is removed in 2026-04 and SKU sharing is on for every fulfillment service; remove reads of the field and logic that assumed a single stocking location.
alerts.quote: Remove any reads/writes of `permitsSkuSharing` from your code for the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases.

alerts.summary: ignoreCompareQuantity is removed in 2026-04; an input that sent ignoreCompareQuantity: true opts out of the check by sending changeFromQuantity: null on each quantity instead.
alerts.quote: Now, to bypass comparison checks, you explicitly pass `null` to the `changeFromQuantity` field.

alerts.summary: From 2026-04, inventoryAdjustQuantities, inventoryMoveQuantities, inventorySetOnHandQuantities and productVariantsBulkUpdate quantity adjustments fail at runtime unless each change sends changeFromQuantity (the expected quantity, or null to opt out); the schema does not mark it required.
alerts.quote: This is a breaking change. Note that even though the `changeFromQuantity` field doesn't show up as mandatory at the schema level, calling these mutations without passing in `null` or passing in the current actual quantity will result in an error at runtime.

alerts.summary: fulfillmentOrderCancel userErrors change type to FulfillmentOrderCancelError with a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderCancel` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderCancelError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: fulfillmentOrderMove userErrors change type to a specific error type with a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderMove` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderMoveUserError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: collectionReorderProducts userErrors change type to CollectionReorderProductsUserError, which adds a code field; fragments on UserError there need updating.
alerts.quote: Starting with version 2025-10, the `userErrors` GraphQL type in the GraphQL Admin API's [`collectionReorderProducts`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/collectionReorderProducts) mutation will be updated to `CollectionReorderProductsUserError`.

alerts.summary: From 2026-07, customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate requires the gateway payment method identifier on Stripe, Authorize.net and Braintree inputs; a call that omits it fails validation.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2026-07, the payment method identifier field is now required

alerts.summary: Explicit metafield access grants no longer work and their schema members are removed; code that reads or sets grants must use the definition access settings instead.
alerts.quote: existing explicit grants in the system will stop working on February 24, 2025.

alerts.summary: draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout is deprecated and removed in 2026-01; Shopify names draftOrderComplete instead, which takes different arguments.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2025-07, the `draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout` mutation has been deprecated. Please use the `draftOrderComplete` mutation instead.

alerts.summary: These PriceListUserErrorCode values are never returned and are removed from the schema; code that compares against them should drop those branches.
alerts.quote: Starting in API version 2025-04, [PriceListErrorCode](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/enums/PriceListUserErrorCode) values that are currently not returned by the API will be hidden.

alerts.summary: SubscriptionMailingAddress is replaced by MailingAddress on subscription delivery methods; fragments on SubscriptionMailingAddress must target MailingAddress.
alerts.quote: As of the 2025-07 version of the GraphQL Admin API, we've deprecated the [`SubscriptionMailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/SubscriptionMailingAddress) object. Use the [`MailingAddress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/MailingAddress) object instead.

alerts.summary: Collections move from one ruleSet to a multi-source model in 2026-07; collections that use new features are hidden from older versions. Migrating rule sets to sources is a model change, not a rename.
alerts.quote: The 2026-07 release replaces a collection’s single `ruleSet` with a multi-source model in the GraphQL Admin API.

alerts.summary: metafieldInteger collection conditions are removed in 2027-01; metafieldInt replaces them, and its value changes type from Int to String, so literals must change too.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2027-01`, the `metafieldInteger` collection source condition inputs and types is removed from GraphQL Admin API. If you use `metafieldInteger` to create or read collection source conditions, you need to migrate to `metafieldInt` before you upgrade to API version `2027-01`.

alerts.summary: Cumulative marketing engagements are deprecated and isCumulative defaults to false; integrations must send daily, non-cumulative metrics.
alerts.quote: The `isCumulative` argument to the `marketingEngagementCreate` mutation is being deprecated, defaulting to `false`. Please update your integration to send non-cumulative engagements, as needed.

alerts.summary: EventBridge and Pub/Sub webhook mutations and the callbackUrl filter are deprecated for webhookSubscriptionCreate/Update and the uri field, which take a different input shape (and uri is a String, not a URL).
alerts.quote: Use the new `uri` field in [`webhookSubscriptionCreate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/mutations/webhookSubscriptionCreate)/[`webhookSubscriptionUpdate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/mutations/webhooksubscriptionupdate) mutations and [`webhookSubscriptions`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/queries/webhooksubscriptions) query instead of the deprecated endpoint-specific mutations and [`callbackUrl`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-10/queries/webhooksubscriptions#arguments-callbackUrl) field.

alerts.summary: GiftCardCreateInput.initialValue is deprecated for initialAmount, which is a MoneyInput rather than a Decimal, so the value must be rewritten with its currency.
alerts.quote: If your app creates gift cards directly, migrate from the deprecated `initialValue` field to `initialAmount`.

alerts.summary: ProductVariant.barcode is deprecated for the barcodes connection and input; barcode still reads and writes the first barcode, but the replacement is a list, not a rename.
alerts.quote: `ProductVariant.barcode` is now deprecated, but nothing breaks today and `barcode` keeps working:

alerts.summary: OrderTransaction.authorizationCode is deprecated for paymentId, which returns a Shopify identifier rather than the provider value, so stored values and reconciliation must change too.
alerts.quote: **Warning:** `paymentId` returns a Shopify-specific identifier, which differs from the provider-specific value in `authorizationCode`. Ensure your systems are updated to store and reconcile using this new ID format.

alerts.summary: InventoryItem.variant is deprecated for the variants connection, so selections need first:, edges or nodes rather than a rename.
alerts.quote: The `InventoryItem.variant` field has been deprecated and will be removed in a future API version. Use the new `InventoryItem.variants` connection instead.

alerts.summary: functionId inputs are deprecated for functionHandle, the handle in shopify.extension.toml; the value differs, so the code must send the handle instead of a looked-up ID.
alerts.quote: All GraphQL mutations that currently accept `functionId` will accept `functionHandle`.

alerts.summary: MetaobjectAdminAccess PRIVATE and PUBLIC_READ are deprecated and never returned; code that sends or compares them should stop.
alerts.quote: by deprecating the `PRIVATE` and `PUBLIC_READ` values. These values are now obsolete and are never returned by the API.

alerts.summary: marketCurrencySettingsUpdate already fails every request and is removed in 2027-01; pass currency settings to marketCreate or marketUpdate instead.
alerts.quote: As of GraphQL Admin API version `2027-01`, the `marketCurrencySettingsUpdate` mutation is removed

alerts.summary: returnRefund and Return.suggestedRefund are deprecated for returnProcess and suggestedFinancialOutcome, which combine disposition and refunds in one call with a different input.
alerts.quote: mutation is deprecated and replaced by the new [`returnProcess`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/returnProcess) mutation. The [`returnProcess`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/returnProcess) mutation streamlines return lifecycle management by combining disposition decisions and financial processing into a single call.

alerts.summary: FeeSale.fee is nullable from 2025-07 when the fee was deleted; code that reads it must handle null.
alerts.quote: As of 2025-07, the `FeeSale.fee` field is now nullable, meaning a `Fee` can be null if it has been deleted.

alerts.summary: On shops that use market-driven shipping, merchant-owned delivery profile reads may be stale and writes do not change live shipping; app-owned profiles are unaffected.
alerts.quote: When a shop uses market-driven shipping, the legacy delivery profile fields and mutations in the Admin GraphQL API no longer represent the shop’s live merchant-owned shipping configuration. Reads may return a stale snapshot of the legacy configuration, and writes may succeed without errors but will not update the merchant’s live shipping settings.

alerts.summary: orderCancel(refund:) is deprecated for refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund, a nested input rather than a renamed argument.
alerts.quote: If you want to continue to issue refunds to the original payments methods on order cancellation, replace your usages of the [`refund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refund) with the new [`refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refundMethod.fields.originalPaymentMethodsRefund) going forward.

alerts.summary: ShopPlan.displayName is deprecated for publicDisplayName, which returns a standardized set of names (Shopify is now Grow), so values differ.
alerts.quote: Please note that the `displayName` field will be deprecated in the future. We recommend updating your applications to use the `publicDisplayName` field to ensure compatibility with future updates.

alerts.summary: Cart tax and duty amounts are deprecated with no replacement; they are calculated at checkout.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2025-01`, we're deprecating the [tax and duty](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2024-01/objects/Cart#field-cost) fields in Storefront API Cart. Tax and Duties are calculated at Checkout where they can be finalized with the complete context of the buyer's information, ensuring greater accuracy.

alerts.summary: Cart buyer identity deliveryAddressPreferences is deprecated (and removed from the input in 2025-01) for CartDelivery.addresses and the cartDeliveryAddresses mutations, a different shape.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2025-01, the [`deliveryAddressPreferences`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/objects/CartBuyerIdentity#field-deliveryaddresspreferences) field on the `CartBuyerIdentity` object is deprecated. Use the new [`addresses`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/objects/CartDelivery#field-addresses) field on the `CartDelivery` object instead.

alerts.summary: Cart.discountAllocations and discountApplication on cart discount allocations are deprecated; sourceDiscountApplication returns the configured value rather than the per-line amount, so totals computed from value change.
alerts.quote: field is deprecated. Use `sourceDiscountApplication` instead. Note: the `value` field on `discountApplication` incorrectly returns the per-line allocated amount rather than the configured discount amount (for example, a $10 fixed discount allocated as $4 to one line shows `value: $4`). The new `sourceDiscountApplication` field returns the correct value.

alerts.summary: ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION is no longer emitted and is removed from the inventory user error codes in 2026-10; code that compares against it should drop that branch.
alerts.quote: If your app currently handles `ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION`, you can safely remove any logic that depends on this specific error.

alerts.summary: Market.currencySettings is nullable from 2025-04; null means the settings are inherited from the parent market, so readers must handle null.
alerts.quote: is now nullable. A null value indicates that the currency settings are inherited from the parent market.

alerts.summary: MarketWebPresence.market is deprecated and nullable because a web presence can belong to several markets or none; the markets connection replaces it, a list rather than a rename.
alerts.quote: A web presence can now exist without a market and can also be assigned to multiple markets. The field [`MarketWebPresence.market`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#field-market) is deprecated in favour of [`MarketWebPresence.markets`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#connection-markets), which allows for this expanded functionality.

alerts.summary: SellingPlanPercentagePriceAdjustment.adjustmentPercentage changes from Int to Float in 2025-01; code that assumes an integer percentage must accept fractions.
alerts.quote: This field, which facilitates the percentage price adjustment for a selling plan's pricing policy, will transition from an [`Int`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2025-01/scalars/Int) data type to a

alerts.summary: cartDiscountCodesUpdate requires the discountCodes argument from 2026-01; calls without it, which never changed the cart, now fail validation.
alerts.quote: the `cartDiscountCodesUpdate` mutation now requires the `discountCodes` argument to be included. Previously, mutation calls without the `discountCodes` argument were allowed, but would not actually modify the cart in any way.

alerts.summary: Across all supported API versions, marketCreate and marketUpdate can reject currency or tax-display settings for managed-mode, merchant-managed non-retail US markets; omit unnecessary settings or supply the required US-only or multinational defaults and handle validation errors.
alerts.quote: The validation only applies when a request supplies `currencySettings` or `priceInclusions`, so requests that omit these inputs are unchanged.

alerts.summary: Managed-mode product publishing now requires Shop alongside dependent channels: unstable requests can fail while dated GraphQL and REST versions can automatically alter publications, so coordinate Shop and dependent-channel changes and handle validation failures.
alerts.quote: For stores that use Shopify Tax managed mode, products published to Online Store, Headless, Hydrogen, or Buy Button must also be published to Shop.

alerts.summary: Custom-line-item taxable inputs are deprecated in 2027-01 and ignored for managed-mode stores in every version; select an appropriate productCategoryId for item tax treatment or use customer, company, or company-location tax exemption for an entire draft order.
alerts.quote: * For stores using Shopify Tax managed mode, `taxable` is ignored on custom line items in every API version. The product category sets tax treatment, and a custom line item with no category is taxed at the standard rate. For all other stores, `taxable` works as before.

alerts.summary: Checkout footer visibility no longer implies that Shopify-provided transaction information is hidden; update branding previews and visual tests to allow that information when merchant-configurable content is HIDDEN.
alerts.quote: All checkout and Thank you pages can display the additional Shopify-provided transaction information in the footer when visibility is set to `HIDDEN`.

alerts.summary: First sign-ins now set Customer.state to ENABLED and trigger customers/enable and customers/update webhooks; review state-based and webhook-driven welcome, loyalty, and synchronization logic for these newly qualifying customers.
alerts.quote: A customer's first sign-in to [customer accounts](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/customers/customer-accounts/new-customer-accounts) now sets [`Customer.state`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/objects/Customer#field-Customer.fields.state) to `ENABLED` and sends the `customers/enable` and `customers/update` webhooks.

alerts.summary: A one-time update enabled previously signed-in customers without webhooks or consistently changing updated_at, so reconcile using Customer.state rather than relying only on webhook delivery or timestamp-based synchronization.
alerts.quote: Don't rely on `updated_at` to find these customers, because the update didn't change it for all of them.

alerts.summary: Exclusive `>` timestamp bounds without fractional seconds in Admin GraphQL connection query arguments now exclude the entire specified second; review incremental sync queries and, if same-second records must not be missed, use `>=` and deduplicate by `id`.
alerts.quote: As of `2026-10`, when a `>` value has no fractional seconds, the filter starts after the end of that second (`12:00:02.999999`).

alerts.summary: Cart operations that leave the cart unchanged no longer emit carts/update webhooks; update integrations that expect a notification for every cart request to rely on actual cart changes instead.
alerts.quote: Cart operations that leave the cart unchanged, for example, resubmitting the same values a cart already has, no longer trigger a `carts/update` webhook.

alerts.summary: Customer Account API requests now share a 3000-requests-per-minute limit per customer per store across all apps; handle HTTP 429 responses by waiting for the Retry-After duration before retrying.
alerts.quote: The Customer Account API now enforces a per-customer rate limit of `3000` requests per minute per store, shared across all apps.

alerts.summary: Hydrogen analytics destinations now wait for consent and receive earlier events after registration; ensure integrations handle delayed and replayed event delivery.
alerts.quote: * **Consent-aware analytics destinations:** Every analytics destination waits for consent, then receives the events that happened before it was registered, so nothing is lost while the shopper decides.

alerts.summary: Rollout-managed discounts can have availability and buyer reach that native dates alone do not describe; request read_rollouts access and combine Discount.rollouts schedules, effective allocation, activation or expiration changes, and sales-channel restrictions with existing discount data.
alerts.quote: When a discount is part of a Rollout, its native dates alone don't describe its availability.

alerts.summary: Admin GraphQL versions before 2026-10 filter out some Rollout-managed discounts; upgrade to 2026-10 or later and account for Rollout availability to avoid incomplete discount results.
alerts.quote: On Admin GraphQL API versions earlier than `2026-10`, discounts are filtered out if they are active but may not reach all buyers, or if their status differs from the status inferred from native dates.

alerts.summary: Before upgrading to 2027-01, replace metafieldInteger collection condition inputs and read type conditions with their metafieldInt equivalents, and change integer condition values from Int to String to avoid validation errors.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2027-01`, the `metafieldInteger` collection source condition inputs and types is removed from GraphQL Admin API.

alerts.summary: The flat SMS marketing consent fields on CustomerPhoneNumber are deprecated; plan to migrate queries to the structured smsMarketingConsent field.
alerts.quote: The existing flat SMS marketing consent fields on `CustomerPhoneNumber` remain available for backward compatibility but are now deprecated.

alerts.summary: Tax calculation requests and tax summary webhook summary sections now use GIDs for entity references, so update ID parsing, validation, storage, and comparisons instead of assuming numeric IDs; top-level shop_id and order_id remain integers.
alerts.quote: Starting with API version 2027-01, third-party tax apps will receive [Global IDs (GIDs)](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/gids) in tax calculation requests and tax summary webhook payloads for all entity references of the summary section.

alerts.summary: Segment queries using the old function syntax must replace `= true`/`= false` with `MATCHES`/`NOT MATCHES` and rewrite function parameters using their own operators inside the match expression.
alerts.quote: As of GraphQL Admin API version 2026-10, functions in the segment query language now use the operators `MATCHES`/`NOT MATCHES` instead of `= true`/`= false`.

alerts.summary: The segment-query named dates `12_months_ago`, `90_days_ago`, `30_days_ago`, and `7_days_ago` are deprecated; migrate queries to date offsets.
alerts.quote: Additionally, the following [named dates](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopifyql/segment-query-language-reference#nameddate) have been deprecated: `12_months_ago`, `90_days_ago`, `30_days_ago`, `7_days_ago`.

alerts.summary: Events subscription queries exceeding the new 100-point complexity limit must be optimized or split into multiple subscriptions while preserving the data handlers need; Classic Webhooks are unaffected.
alerts.quote: We’re reducing the query complexity limit for Events subscriptions from 250 to 100 points.

alerts.summary: The marketCurrencySettingsUpdate mutation and its payload and error types are removed in 2027-01, causing requests referencing them to fail validation; pass currency settings directly to marketCreate or marketUpdate instead.
alerts.quote: As of GraphQL Admin API version `2027-01`, the `marketCurrencySettingsUpdate` mutation is removed, along with the `MarketCurrencySettingsUpdatePayload`, `MarketCurrencySettingsUserError`, and `MarketCurrencySettingsUserErrorCode` types.

alerts.summary: API version 2027-01 removes automaticDiscounts and its connection and edge types; migrate to discountNodes with query: "method:automatic", move inline fragments onto DiscountNode.discount, and regenerate GraphQL types.
alerts.quote: The `DiscountAutomaticConnection` and `DiscountAutomaticEdge` types are also removed, because no other fields in the schema return them.

alerts.summary: Events payloads now represent `fields_changed` as an object instead of a flat array; update consumers to read its `added`, `updated`, and `removed` arrays.
alerts.quote: The flat array becomes an object containing three arrays: `added`, `updated`, and `removed`.

alerts.summary: Parent-path Events triggers must end in `.*` on the next deployment of `shopify.app.toml`; update parent triggers while leaving leaf triggers unchanged.
alerts.quote: Existing subscriptions continue to work, but you must update parent triggers to the new syntax the next time you deploy `shopify.app.toml`.

alerts.summary: Events deliveries no longer include `shopify-event-id` or `shopify-resource-id`; remove dependencies on these headers and update Shopify API packages to their latest versions.
alerts.quote: Events deliveries no longer include `shopify-event-id` or `shopify-resource-id`.

alerts.summary: Events subscription configurations using the `update` action must provide at least one trigger; add triggers where missing, noting that existing subscriptions continue to work.
alerts.quote: Event subscriptions with the `update` action require at least one trigger to be present.

alerts.summary: Dynamic costing for metafieldsSet can exhaust rate limits faster; group writes by owner, monitor response costs, and back off and retry on THROTTLED errors.
alerts.quote: Apps making high-volume, cross-owner requests (for example, updating 25 distinct orders in one request) will see an increase in query cost and may consume their API rate limit bucket faster.

alerts.summary: Reads of deprecated ProductVariant.barcode silently omit additional barcodes; migrate identifier-sync reads to the barcodes connection and handle multiple results.
alerts.quote: Once a second barcode is added to a variant, an integration reading only barcode sees one of them with no signal that others exist.

alerts.summary: Legacy barcode writes affect only the first barcode and blank values can expose another barcode rather than clear all identifiers; review clearing logic and explicitly manage the full set when migrating to barcodes.
alerts.quote: * Writing `barcode` updates the first barcode in the `barcodes` connection and leaves the variant's other barcodes untouched. Sending a blank value clears the first barcode and replaces it with the next barcode in the set until there are no barcodes remaining.

alerts.summary: Barcode filters on products and productVariants now match any barcode on a variant; review assumptions that search results match only the legacy first barcode.
alerts.quote: * The `barcode` filter on the products and productVariants queries now matches any barcode on a variant.

alerts.summary: Hydrogen variant-specific links now select the named variant rather than the product default; review storefront code that assumes linked products open on their default variant.
alerts.quote: * **Variant links:** Links that name a variant, like the ones Shopify submits to a Google Shopping feed, now open on that variant instead of the product's default.

alerts.summary: Starting October 1, 2026, script tag creation and updates fail through GraphQL Admin mutations and REST Admin POST/PUT requests across all API versions; migrate to app embed blocks or web pixels as appropriate.
alerts.quote: Starting October 1, 2026, the `scriptTagCreate` and `scriptTagUpdate` mutations will return an user error, and the `ScriptTag` REST Admin API resource will reject `POST` and `PUT`.

alerts.summary: On March 1, 2027, existing storefront script tags stop loading JavaScript; replace them with theme app extension app embed blocks, or web pixels for analytics-only scripts.
alerts.quote: * **March 1, 2027**: Shopify will stop injecting script tags into storefronts.

alerts.summary: Hydrogen now emits page-view events on every navigation; review manual navigation tracking to avoid duplicate analytics events.
alerts.quote: * **Standard page view events:** Hydrogen storefronts used to report only the first page load, leaving client-side navigations invisible to analytics and performance tooling. Every navigation now emits a page view, matching how liquid themes report events.

alerts.summary: Active draft-order and open transfer/shipment holds move from reserved to committed quantities, so update inventory interpretation and reporting without assuming committed identifies only these holds.
alerts.quote: * For draft orders, transfers, and shipments, quantities that previously appeared under `reserved` will now appear under `committed`.

alerts.summary: Shipping-address updates through GraphQL orderUpdate or REST order update now recalculate taxes on eligible unfulfilled orders; reread taxes and totals after updating, compare balances, and handle any resulting payable or refundable balance.
alerts.quote: As of API version **2026-10**, changing the shipping address on an unfulfilled order through the [orderUpdate GraphQL mutation](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/orderUpdate) or the [REST Admin API order update endpoint](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest/2026-10/resources/order#put-orders-order-id) recalculates the order's taxes against the new destination.

alerts.summary: Queries with invalid metafield filters now return errors instead of silently ignoring invalid predicates; before upgrading, ensure each filtered metafield has a definition that allows filtering and supports the comparison used.
alerts.quote: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results.

alerts.summary: Events subscriptions with no triggers or parent triggers can now receive metafield-change events on supported resources; review handler assumptions and use targeted metafield triggers to restrict changes to the namespaces and keys your app needs.
alerts.quote: If your subscription has no `triggers`, or subscribes to a parent trigger such as `product`, it can now receive events for metafield changes on supported resources too.

alerts.summary: Orders with no remaining fulfillable items now report FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED instead of UNFULFILLED; update enum handling and UNFULFILLED-based branches or filters when adopting 2026-10.
alerts.quote: * If your app branches on or filters by `UNFULFILLED`, note that orders with no fulfillable items report `FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED` instead on 2026-10 and later.

alerts.summary: Checkout UI extensions using `useBuyerJourneyIntercept` or `block_progress` must migrate business-rule enforcement to cart and checkout validation Functions and discount-code rejection to discount Functions before these deprecated APIs are removed in a future version.
alerts.quote: Starting in version `2026-07`, the [`useBuyerJourneyIntercept`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/checkout-ui-extensions/latest/target-apis/checkout-apis/buyer-journey-api#useBuyerJourneyIntercept) hook on checkout UI extensions, and the [`block_progress`](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/checkout/capabilities#block-progress) capability it depends on, are deprecated.

alerts.summary: Migrate merchant shipping configuration integrations from the delivery profile API to the Markets API before rollout reaches affected merchants, beginning October 1, 2026 and completing July 1, 2027; app-owned delivery profiles remain on the delivery profile API.
alerts.quote: * If your app reads, creates, or updates merchant shipping settings through the delivery profile API, you’ll need to update it. Market-driven shipping will start rolling out to merchants on October 1, 2026, and all merchants will be on it by July 1, 2027.

alerts.summary: Cumulative marketing engagements are deprecated and `isCumulative` defaults to `false`; update integrations to send non-cumulative metrics aggregated for each day.
alerts.quote: The `isCumulative` argument to the `marketingEngagementCreate` mutation is being deprecated, defaulting to `false`.

alerts.summary: Creating a carrier service with GraphQL carrierServiceCreate or REST POST /admin/api/{version}/carrier_services.json no longer automatically adds its rates to the General shipping profile; explicitly configure carrier-calculated rates through shipping profile APIs or direct merchants to add them in Shopify admin.
alerts.quote: Starting with GraphQL Admin API version 2026-10, creating a carrier service no longer automatically adds it to the shop’s General shipping profile.

alerts.summary: Queries selecting DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule or referencing removed PriceRule types break in 2026-10; select discountTitle and discountCode directly and remove references to the legacy types.
alerts.quote: As a result, removing `priceRule` also removes the `PriceRule` object and its related types from the public schema in `2026-10` and later.

alerts.summary: The ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION error code is removed from four inventory mutation error enums in API version 2026-10; remove code that references or handles these enum values.
alerts.quote: The `ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION` error will be removed from `InventoryAdjustQuantities`, `InventoryMoveQuantities`, `InventorySetOnHandQuantities`, and `InventorySetQuantitiesUserErrorCode` as of API version 2026-10.

alerts.summary: Pre-2026-07 collection queries omit collections using new model features; upgrade to 2026-07 and migrate legacy ruleSet reads and writes to sources and the new collection mutation arguments.
alerts.quote: * If your app reads `Collection.ruleSet` or writes `input.ruleSet`, switch to `Collection.sources` and the new `collection` argument. The legacy shape can’t express multiple sources, exclusion conditions, or shareable sources, and collections that use those features are filtered out of pre-2026-07 query results.

alerts.summary: Gift card creation deprecates GiftCardCreateInput.initialValue; migrate to initialAmount with both an amount and currency before upgrading to 2026-07.
alerts.quote: 1. If you create gift cards using `giftCardCreate`, replace `initialValue` with `initialAmount` before you upgrade to `2026-07`.

alerts.summary: All public apps using non-expiring offline access tokens must migrate to expiring tokens, including token exchange, storage updates, and refresh handling, by January 1, 2027 to avoid Admin API authentication errors.
alerts.quote: Starting January 1, 2027, all public apps must use [expiring offline access tokens](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/access-tokens/offline-access-tokens#expiring-vs-non-expiring-offline-tokens) when calling the Admin API.

alerts.summary: MetaobjectAdminAccess.PRIVATE and MetaobjectAdminAccess.PUBLIC_READ are removed in API version 2027-01; remove obsolete references and review any access-handling logic that uses them.
alerts.quote: We are updating the [`MetaobjectAdminAccess`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/enums/MetaobjectAdminAccess) enum by deprecating the `PRIVATE` and `PUBLIC_READ` values.

alerts.summary: Checkouts can now contain multiple delivery groups for shipping and pickup, so remove single-delivery-group assumptions and test mixed-method carts in feature preview.
alerts.quote: * Checkouts can have multiple deliveryGroups: each group represents how different items are to be fulfilled.

alerts.summary: Orders can now mix shipping and pickup fulfillment orders, so inspect each fulfillment order's delivery method and update routing and calculations instead of assuming one method per order.
alerts.quote: * Orders can contain fulfillment orders with different delivery methods (SHIPPING and PICK\_UP) within the same order.

alerts.summary: Omitting appliesOnSubscription now defaults to true on app discount inputs across all active API versions; review assumptions about the omitted value, although Shopify states checkout behavior and explicitly supplied values are unchanged.
alerts.quote: The default value of `appliesOnSubscription` has been changed from `false` to `true` on the [`DiscountCodeAppInput`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/input-objects/DiscountCodeAppInput) and [`DiscountAutomaticAppInput`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/input-objects/DiscountAutomaticAppInput) input types in GraphQL Admin API.

alerts.summary: For multi-capturable orders with pending captures, OrderTransaction.totalUnsettledSet no longer double-counts pending capture amounts across all API versions; review calculations and tests that relied on the inflated value, although existing queries need no changes.
alerts.quote: Previously, when a capture was pending, `totalUnsettledSet` was double-counting by incorrectly returning the authorization amount plus the pending capture amount.

alerts.summary: Calling inventoryActivate without available or onHand now preserves pre-activation quantities instead of resetting them to zero; review reset-dependent logic and explicitly set quantities where needed.
alerts.quote: * **GraphQL**: In the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases, using the `inventoryActivate` mutation without an `available` or `onHand` argument will preserve the pre-activation quantities.

alerts.summary: POST inventory_levels/connect.json now retains pre-activation quantities; review and update any business logic that relies on activation resetting inventory to zero.
alerts.quote: * **REST**: In the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases, `POST` requests to [`inventory_levels/connect.json`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest/latest/resources/inventorylevel#post-inventory-levels-connect) will retain the pre-activation quantities.

alerts.summary: On mobile, TitleBar primary actions become icon-only buttons defaulting to a plus icon and secondary actions move to the overflow menu; review affected embedded apps and pass an explicit primary-action icon if the default is inappropriate.
alerts.quote: * The primary action now displays as an icon-only button in the mobile header, rather than in a bottom bar with icon and text.

alerts.summary: Starting April 15, 2026, embedded apps on Shopify Mobile must account for the native floating bottom bar in custom fixed-bottom UI by using var(--shopify-safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) in their CSS.
alerts.quote: However, if your app has custom fixed-bottom UI elements, use `var(--shopify-safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)` in your CSS to ensure these elements are positioned above the native floating bottom bar.

alerts.summary: Cart.discountAllocations is deprecated; migrate allocation queries to cart lines with lineLevelOnly: false and delivery groups, or use Cart.discountApplications when reading discount applications rather than allocations.
alerts.quote: * The [`cart.discountAllocations`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2026-07/objects/Cart#field-discountAllocations) field is deprecated. Use `cart.lines[].discountAllocations(lineLevelOnly: false)` and `cart.deliveryGroups[].discountAllocations` instead.

alerts.summary: Cart discount allocation discountApplication fields are deprecated; migrate to sourceDiscountApplication and review calculations because value reports the configured discount amount instead of the per-line allocated amount.
alerts.quote: * The [`cartDiscountAllocation.discountApplication`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2026-07/interfaces/CartDiscountAllocation#field-discountApplication) field is deprecated. Use `sourceDiscountApplication` instead. Note: the `value` field on `discountApplication` incorrectly returns the per-line allocated amount rather than the configured discount amount (for example, a $10 fixed discount allocated as $4 to one line shows `value: $4`). The new `sourceDiscountApplication` field returns the correct value.

alerts.summary: The fulfillmentOrderCancel mutation returns a mutation-specific error type instead of generic user errors; update error type references and fragments to match the new response type.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderCancel` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderCancelError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: Cancelling fulfillment orders with reported progress is now restricted; update cancellation flows to handle rejections and inspect the returned error codes.
alerts.quote: As part of this feature, cancelling fulfillment orders with reported progress is now restricted, and the enhanced error responses help developers handle these restrictions more effectively.

alerts.summary: The payment method identifier inputs for customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate become required; supply the appropriate Stripe, Authorize.net, or Braintree identifier before adopting API version 2026-07.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2026-07, the payment method identifier field is now required when using the `customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate` mutation with Stripe, Authorize.net, or Braintree inputs.

alerts.summary: The fulfillmentOrderMove user-error response changes type; update typed response handling and any fragments targeting the generic UserError type.
alerts.quote: The `fulfillmentOrderMove` mutation now returns a specific `fulfillmentOrderMoveUserError` type instead of the generic `userError` type.

alerts.summary: Moving fulfillment orders with reported progress is now restricted; handle failed fulfillmentOrderMove calls using the enhanced user-error response.
alerts.quote: As part of this feature, moving fulfillment orders with reported progress is now restricted, and the enhanced error responses help developers handle these restrictions more effectively.

alerts.summary: The REST Admin API is removing order line item fields `pre_tax_price` and `pre_tax_price_set`; migrate affected pricing reads to the GraphQL Admin API.
alerts.quote: The `pre_tax_price` and `pre_tax_price_set` fields on order line items in the [REST Admin API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest) are being removed.

alerts.summary: Public apps created on or after April 1, 2026 that call the Admin API must implement expiring offline access tokens and token refresh handling.
alerts.quote: Starting April 1, 2026, all new public apps must request and use [expiring offline access tokens](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization/access-tokens#offline-access-tokens).

alerts.summary: Update ShopifyQL queries to use the mapped sales-reversal field names before deprecated returns fields are removed in API version 2026-07; older API versions retain access only until 2027-04.
alerts.quote: Deprecated fields will be removed in version 2026-07, but will still be accessible via older API versions until 2027-04.

alerts.summary: The inventorySetScheduledChanges mutation is removed in API version 2026-07 with no replacement; remove calls and redesign any scheduled inventory workflows.
alerts.quote: The [`inventorySetScheduledChanges`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/unstable/mutations/inventorysetscheduledchanges) mutation will be removed from the GraphQL Admin API in version `2026-07`.

alerts.summary: The `id` field is removed from `checkouts/create` and `checkouts/update` webhook payloads; update handlers and infrastructure to reference checkouts using `token` instead.
alerts.quote: The `id` field has been removed from the following webhook topics:

alerts.summary: The `checkout_id` field is removed from `orders/cancelled`, `orders/create`, `orders/fulfilled`, `orders/link_requested`, `orders/paid`, `orders/partially_fulfilled`, and `orders/updated` webhook payloads; update handlers and infrastructure to use `checkout_token` instead.
alerts.quote: The `checkout_id` field has been removed from the following webhook topics:

alerts.summary: Queries of merchant-managed delivery profiles can return separate legacy method definitions for tiered rates and free conditions, changing counts; review assumptions and migrate to the new rate-group and condition fields where needed.
alerts.quote: * If a method definition includes multiple rate definitions, then each additional rate is represented as a separate method definition with its own `rateProvider` and `methodConditions`.

alerts.summary: Writes to merchant-managed delivery profiles must migrate from legacy participant, rate-definition and condition inputs to the new rate-group inputs to avoid unexpected behavior with multiple tiered rates.
alerts.quote: The following legacy fields will become obsolete when merchants start using multiple tiered rates:

alerts.summary: In Admin GraphQL and REST API versions 2026-04 and later, JSON metafield writes exceeding 128KB will fail unless exempt; reduce payload sizes or request access to higher limits, noting that apps using JSON fields before April 1, 2026 retain the 2MB limit.
alerts.quote: When using API version 2026-04 or later, JSON type metafield writes will be limited to 128KB.

alerts.summary: In Customer Account API versions 2026-04 and later, JSON metafield writes exceeding 128KB will fail unless exempt; reduce payload sizes or request access to higher limits, noting that apps using JSON fields before April 1, 2026 retain the 2MB limit.
alerts.quote: When using API version 2026-04 or later, JSON type metafield writes will be limited to 128KB.

alerts.summary: The entry lists the Storefront API as affected by the 128KB JSON metafield write limit from version 2026-04; check any write workflows for oversized values or obtain an exemption, while leaving reads of existing large values unchanged.
alerts.quote: When using API version 2026-04 or later, JSON type metafield writes will be limited to 128KB.

alerts.summary: Subscription billing failures are being reclassified into more specific error codes in 2026-04 and unstable; review error handling and retry logic rather than treating the mapping table as one-to-one renames.
alerts.quote: * In the `unstable` version, you’ll start seeing new error codes display, along with fewer `AUTHENTICATION_ERROR` and `PAYMENT_METHOD_DECLINED` errors.

alerts.summary: Subscription billing attempts on 2026-01 and earlier can return different existing error codes for the same failures; review code-specific handling, retry policies, and monitoring assumptions.
alerts.quote: * If you’re on version `2026-01` or earlier, you might still notice a shift in error volumes across existing error codes. We improved our mapping so that some errors previously categorized as generic decline errors, such as `PAYMENT_METHOD_DECLINED`, are now mapped more explicitly to existing error codes. For example, we can map more cases to `INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS` instead of generic declines.

alerts.summary: Parsing OrderTransaction.receiptJson can break without a breaking API change; migrate dependencies to stable typed fields or retrieve necessary provider-specific details directly from the payment provider.
alerts.quote: * Changes to the shape or keys inside `receiptJson` may occur **without being treated as a breaking API change**.

alerts.summary: Admin GraphQL Event data and REST events data older than one year are no longer accessible; update code that depends on older events.
alerts.quote: Access to `events` data older than one year is no longer available via the [Admin GraphQL `Event` interface](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/interfaces/Event) or the [Admin REST `events` resource](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest/latest/resources/event).

alerts.summary: Cart Transform Function runtime failures now return MERCHANDISE_LINE_TRANSFORMERS_RUN_ERROR instead of INVALID; update cart error handling to recognize the new code while retaining INVALID handling for other validation errors.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2026-04, the Storefront API will return a `MERCHANDISE_LINE_TRANSFORMERS_RUN_ERROR` [cart error code](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/latest/enums/CartErrorCode) when a [Cart Transform Function](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/functions/latest/cart-transform) encounters a runtime error during cart operations such as [`cartCreate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/latest/mutations/cartCreate) or [`cartLinesAdd`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/latest/mutations/cartLinesAdd).

alerts.summary: The deliveryShippingOriginAssign mutation is deprecated and slated for removal in a future API version; stop using it and evaluate supported alternatives for assigning shipping origins.
alerts.quote: Developers are advised to cease using this mutation, as it will be removed in a future API version.

alerts.summary: Return reason enum inputs and output fields are deprecated; migrate inputs to returnReasonDefinitionId and update return queries and consuming code to use returnReasonDefinition objects.
alerts.quote: The `returnReason` field on input types and return line item types is deprecated.

alerts.summary: Remove queries for FulfillmentService.permitsSkuSharing and any mutation arguments not covered by a true-value removal, and review logic that assumes fulfillment-service inventory is restricted to one location.
alerts.quote: * **GraphQL**: In the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases, if you are querying for the `permitsSkuSharing` field or sending it in mutations in API version, you will begin receiving errors.

alerts.summary: Remove REST reads and writes of permitsSkuSharing because GET responses omit it and POST/PUT requests ignore it, and review logic that assumes inventory can only be stocked at one location.
alerts.quote: * **REST**: In the `unstable` or `2026-04` and later releases, the `permitsSkuSharing` field won't be returned in `GET` requests. In `POST` and `PUT` requests, the `permitsSkuSharing` argument will be ignored.

alerts.summary: When gift card recipient details are missing or invalid, cartCreate and cartLinesAdd now return GIFT_CARD_RECIPIENT_INVALID instead of empty userErrors; handle this error and surface recipient validation feedback to the client.
alerts.quote: As of API version `2026-01`, the Storefront API returns a `GIFT_CARD_RECIPIENT_INVALID` error when adding a gift card to a cart with missing or invalid recipient details, such as in [this example](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/themes/product-merchandising/gift-cards#create-a-form-to-collect-recipient-information).

alerts.summary: OrderTransaction.authorizationCode is deprecated; migrate to paymentId only after updating storage and reconciliation to handle Shopify-specific identifiers instead of provider-specific authorization codes.
alerts.quote: **Warning:** `paymentId` returns a Shopify-specific identifier, which differs from the provider-specific value in `authorizationCode`.

alerts.summary: Before upgrading to 2026-04, remove compareQuantity and ignoreCompareQuantity and explicitly supply changeFromQuantity with the expected current quantity to enable concurrency checks or null to skip them; omitting it causes a runtime error.
alerts.quote: We're making the `changeFromQuantity` field introduced [in `2026-01`](https://shopify.dev/changelog/compare-and-swap-redesign-for-inventory-set-quantities) mandatory and removing the [`compareQuantity`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-01/input-objects/InventoryQuantityInput#fields-compareQuantity) and [`ignoreCompareQuantity`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-01/input-objects/InventorySetQuantitiesInput#fields-ignoreCompareQuantity) fields for the [`inventorySetQuantities`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-04/mutations/inventorysetquantities) mutation.

alerts.summary: Inventory mutations will require `changeFromQuantity`; update affected requests to supply it or use the explicit opt-out.
alerts.quote: * `2026-04`: [Making the `changeFromQuantity` field required (with explict opt-out) for various inventory mutations](https://shopify.dev/changelog/making-changefromquantity-field-required) **(BREAKING)**

alerts.summary: `inventorySetQuantities` will require `changeFromQuantity` with an explicit opt-out and remove the old compare-and-swap fields; update requests to the new concurrency contract.
alerts.quote: * `2026-04`: [Making the `changeFromQuantity` field required (with explict opt-out) for the `inventorySetQuantities` mutation and removing the old compare And swap fields](https://shopify.dev/changelog/finalizing-compare-and-swap-redesign-for-inventory-set-quantities) **(BREAKING)**

alerts.summary: Affected inventory and refund mutations will require the `idempotent` directive; update requests to include the required idempotency protection.
alerts.quote: * `2026-04` [Making the `idempotent` directive required for various inventory and refund mutations](https://shopify.dev/changelog/making-idempotency-mandatory-for-inventory-adjustments-and-refund-mutations) **(BREAKING)**

alerts.summary: Starting in 2026-04, affected inventory mutations reject inputs that omit changeFromQuantity; pass the expected current quantity for concurrency checks or explicitly pass null to opt out.
alerts.quote: Note that even though the `changeFromQuantity` field doesn't show up as mandatory at the schema level, calling these mutations without passing in `null` or passing in the current actual quantity will result in an error at runtime.

alerts.summary: Calls to the listed mutations without `@idempotent` will fail at runtime in version 2026-04; add the directive with an appropriately managed idempotency key before upgrading.
alerts.quote: > **Note**: Even though the idempotency directive doesn't show up as mandatory at the schema level, calling these mutations without an idempotency directive will result in an error at runtime.

alerts.summary: InventoryQuantityInput.compareQuantity and InventorySetQuantitiesInput.ignoreCompareQuantity are removed in 2026-04; migrate to InventoryQuantityInput.changeFromQuantity, passing an integer to check the initial quantity or explicit null to bypass comparison.
alerts.quote: We plan to remove them entirely starting from version `2026-04`.

alerts.summary: InventoryItem.variant is deprecated and will be removed in a future API version; migrate queries and response handling to the paginated InventoryItem.variants connection.
alerts.quote: The `InventoryItem.variant` field has been deprecated and will be removed in a future API version.

alerts.summary: The `tax_summaries/create` webhook's `created_at` timestamp changes to UTC with a `Z` suffix and millisecond precision; update timestamp parsing to handle the new format.
alerts.quote: The `created_at` field from `tax_summaries/create` webhook for tax partners will now return timestamps in UTC format with the `Z` suffix, including millisecond precision.

alerts.summary: Calls to cartDiscountCodesUpdate that omit discountCodes or pass null will fail; supply an explicit non-null list of discount codes.
alerts.quote: As part of the [GraphQL Storefront API 2026-01 release](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/2026-01/mutations/cartdiscountcodesupdate), the `cartDiscountCodesUpdate` mutation now requires the `discountCodes` argument to be included.

alerts.summary: Bulk queries that omit groupObjects now produce ungrouped output by default; explicitly set groupObjects: true if your application depends on grouped output.
alerts.quote: The [`groupObjects`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-01/mutations/bulkoperationrunquery#arguments-groupObjects) argument now defaults to `false`.

alerts.summary: The bulk mutation groupObjects argument is deprecated and does not affect output ordering; remove it from bulkOperationRunMutation calls.
alerts.quote: The [`groupObjects`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2026-01/mutations/bulkoperationrunmutation#arguments-groupObjects) argument is now deprecated.

alerts.summary: Concurrent Cart AJAX and Storefront Cart GraphQL requests now execute rather than potentially being dropped, so remove unintended duplicate cart requests to avoid duplicate changes.
alerts.quote: This is considered a bug fix for both APIs, but may require updates if the theme or storefront is unintentionally sending duplicate requests.

alerts.summary: Excessive concurrent cart requests can now return HTTP 409 from Cart AJAX or a CONFLICT error from Storefront Cart GraphQL, so handle these failures and coordinate concurrent cart updates.
alerts.quote: **Note**: If too many simultaneous requests are receieved, the Cart AJAX API will instead return an HTTP 409 response, while the Storefront Cart GraphQL API will return an error with code "CONFLICT" and message "Could not complete cart operation. The cart conflicted with another request".

alerts.summary: Apps using REST or other unsupported product APIs may fail to create or display products with more than 100 variants; migrate to the in-support GraphQL product APIs to support up to 2,048 variants.
alerts.quote: Please note that merchants using apps that are not using the in-support GraphQL product APIs may have a downgraded or broken experience when creating or viewing products with more than 100 variants.

alerts.summary: Legacy shipping-mode fields no longer function and are removed in 2026-04; remove these selections and inputs rather than relying on static query results or no-op mutations.
alerts.quote: The corresponding queries that use these fields now return static data that users should ignore.

alerts.summary: Subscription billing attempts and draft delivery options now use each variant's current shipping requirement rather than a stored subscription-line value; review shipping and tax assumptions when updating variants.
alerts.quote: Subscription contracts now dynamically retrieve the "requires shipping" value from the product variant for each contract line.

alerts.summary: Orders created by subscription billing attempts no longer include a delivery line when no contract lines require shipping; handle missing delivery lines and revised shipping charges and totals.
alerts.quote: If no lines in a subscription contract require shipping, then we no longer add a delivery line to the order.

alerts.summary: From October 31, 2025, shipping-address changes during Draft Order checkout may change product prices based on Markets configuration; set priceOverride or generatePriceOverride on Draft Order line items when creating or updating a Draft Order to preserve pricing.
alerts.quote: Starting from October 31 2025, when a customer updates their shipping address during a Draft Order checkout, product prices may change based on the shop's [Markets configuration](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/markets-new/catalogs).

alerts.summary: Starting October 9, 2025, eligible stores can display remote products that Storefront API responses omit; account for incomplete cart data and exclude remote products from store-specific shipping, discount, loyalty, and recovery logic where applicable.
alerts.quote: Remote products do not yet appear in [Storefront API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront/latest/queries/cart) responses.

alerts.summary: Requests to customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate can now be rate limited; handle throttling and retry requests with backoff.
alerts.quote: The `customerPaymentMethodRemoteCreate` mutation in the Admin API now includes rate limiting to manage excessive API requests and maintain consistent performance for all merchants.

alerts.summary: Creating a fulfillment service with permitsSkuSharing set to false now fails in both GraphQL and REST; send true or omit the parameter, allowing the new service to share SKUs with other locations.
alerts.quote: With the 2025-10 API version, the `permitsSkuSharing` argument has been updated for both the `fulfillmentServiceCreate` mutation and the `FulfillmentService#create` REST endpoint to return an error if a `false` value is passed in.

alerts.summary: CollectionReorderProductsPayload.userErrors changes from [UserError!]! to [CollectionReorderProductsUserError!]!; update typed error handling and fragments that depend on UserError.
alerts.quote: Starting with version 2025-10, the `userErrors` GraphQL type in the GraphQL Admin API's [`collectionReorderProducts`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/collectionReorderProducts) mutation will be updated to `CollectionReorderProductsUserError`.

alerts.summary: Code-discount customerSelection fields are deprecated and will be removed in a future version; migrate queries and mutation inputs to context using its corresponding output and input types.
alerts.quote: For code discounts, `context` replaces [`customerSelection`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/input-objects/DiscountCustomerSelectionInput), which is now marked as deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

alerts.summary: Queries on API versions older than 2025-10 omit automatic discounts restricted to customers or customer segments; upgrade to 2025-10 or later to retrieve those discounts.
alerts.quote: Automatic discounts with customer or customer segment eligibility applied will be filtered out from queries prior to 2025-10.

alerts.summary: The checkout_and_accounts_configurations/update webhook will be removed; unsubscribe before January 1, 2026, and use the Admin API checkoutProfiles query's typOspPagesActive field to track Thank You and Order status page upgrades.
alerts.quote: The `checkout_and_accounts_configurations/update` webhook, originally introduced in API version 2025-04 to help track updates to checkout and accounts configurations, will be removed on January 1, 2026.

alerts.summary: Starting with Storefront API 2025-10, passing an empty addresses array to cartDeliveryAddressesUpdate clears all cart addresses; update callers that do not intend to clear them.
alerts.quote: Starting with API version 2025-10, setting the `addresses` field of the `cartDeliveryAddressesUpdate` mutation to an empty array (`[]`) clears cart addresses.

alerts.summary: As checkout support for selling from all locations is removed through September 30, 2025, recurring subscription orders may encounter more inventory errors; ensure stock is available at fulfillment locations with valid delivery methods for the customer's shipping zone.
alerts.quote: Developers should note that apps using Shopify APIs to manage recurring subscription orders might encounter an increase in errors that occur when products are unavailable at fulfillment locations that ship to the customer.

alerts.summary: ProductVariant.taxCode is deprecated and will be removed in future API versions; remove its use from queries and mutations and update tax calculations or reporting that depend on it.
alerts.quote: The `taxCode` field on `ProductVariant` objects will not be available in future API versions.

alerts.summary: The orderCancel refund argument is deprecated; migrate to refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund to continue refunding original payment methods.
alerts.quote: If you want to continue to issue refunds to the original payments methods on order cancellation, replace your usages of the [`refund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refund) with the new [`refundMethod.originalPaymentMethodsRefund` input](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/orderCancel#arguments-refundMethod.fields.originalPaymentMethodsRefund) going forward.

alerts.summary: DraftOrderPlatformDiscount.discountClass is deprecated; migrate to discountClasses and adapt consumers to handle multiple classes, continuing to use presentationLevel to determine the discount's specific impact on a draft order.
alerts.quote: The `discountClass` field in the `DraftOrderPlatformDiscount` object has been deprecated.

alerts.summary: Starting August 1, 2025, HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1 POST requests to Admin APIs without Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding: chunked will return HTTP 411; update clients to include either header.
alerts.quote: Starting August 1, 2025, all POST requests to Shopify APIs must include either a Content-Length header or Transfer-Encoding: chunked header, or they'll return an HTTP 411 error.

alerts.summary: Starting August 1, 2025, HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1 POST requests to the Storefront API without Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding: chunked will return HTTP 411; update clients to include either header.
alerts.quote: Starting August 1, 2025, all POST requests to Shopify APIs must include either a Content-Length header or Transfer-Encoding: chunked header, or they'll return an HTTP 411 error.

alerts.summary: Starting August 1, 2025, HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1 POST requests to the Customer Account API without Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding: chunked will return HTTP 411; update clients to include either header.
alerts.quote: Starting August 1, 2025, all POST requests to Shopify APIs must include either a Content-Length header or Transfer-Encoding: chunked header, or they'll return an HTTP 411 error.

alerts.summary: Storefront GraphQL queries now error when paginating beyond 25,000 items; add filters to narrow results before pagination.
alerts.quote: * For paginated GraphQL queries (using `first`, `last`, `before`, `after` parameters), queries will now return an error when paginating past the 25,000th item in the array.

alerts.summary: Storefront GraphQL counts now cap at 25,001; update count handling to interpret that value as more than 25,000 rather than an exact total.
alerts.quote: * Any query originating from Liquid or GraphQL for a count will now return a maximum of 25,001 (indicating "more than 25,000") for arrays with more items.

alerts.summary: Update productCreate error handling to inspect payload userErrors for multiple options linked to the same metafield, links to already-linked metafields, linkedMetafieldValue on unlinked options, and simultaneous options and optionValues.
alerts.quote: Starting from 2025-07, the following `productCreate` input issues will be surfaced as `userErrors`:

alerts.summary: CardPaymentDetails.wallet now returns AMAZON_PAY or FACEBOOK_PAY for transactions that previously returned null; update wallet-handling logic to accept these values across all API versions.
alerts.quote: This also enables visibility of `AMAZON_PAY` and `FACEBOOK_PAY` as values on the [`wallet`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/objects/CardPaymentDetails#field-wallet) field of the [`CardPaymentDetails`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/objects/CardPaymentDetails) object.

alerts.summary: When a buyer country belongs to no market, contextual pricing and publishing now use the backup region's market rather than store defaults; review pricing, currency, catalog, and publishing assumptions for these contexts.
alerts.quote: With this change, the market for the `backupRegion` will now be used so currency, catalogs, and other settings from that market will be used when determining pricing and publishing.

alerts.summary: Carrier HTTP 3xx and 4xx responses now trigger backup shipping rates instead of a hard failure; review carrier integrations and checkout tests that rely on these responses suppressing shipping options.
alerts.quote: This change triggers a fallback to backup rates instead of resulting in a hard failure.

alerts.summary: Legacy return-refund workflows using refundCreate, returnRefund, or Return.suggestedRefund are deprecated; migrate to returnProcess and Return.suggestedFinancialOutcome with the necessary input and selection changes.
alerts.quote: The older mutations ([`refundCreate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/refundCreate), [`returnRefund`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/mutations/returnRefund)) and the query field ([`Return.suggestedRefund`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/objects/suggestedRefund)) are deprecated.

alerts.summary: Exchange fulfillment orders are now created only when exchange line items are processed; update return creation and approval workflows to use returnProcess before expecting those fulfillment orders.
alerts.quote: * Exchange fulfillment orders are now created only when exchange line items are processed, ensuring accuracy.

alerts.summary: The Product, Order, and Shipping Discount Function APIs are deprecated; migrate existing extensions to the unified Discount Function API before API version 2026-04.
alerts.quote: If you use the existing APIs, before API version 2026-04 you'll need to update to the new Discount Function API.

alerts.summary: Count queries now default to a limit of 10,000; explicitly pass `limit: null` on affected queries when an uncapped count is required.
alerts.quote: This change introduces a breaking change: all APIs now include a `limit` argument, with a default value of `10000`.

alerts.summary: Across all API versions, app-owned metafields and metaobjects no longer support public access; migrate to a custom namespace if other apps need access.
alerts.quote: In line with last year's [announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog/simplifying-how-metafield-and-metaobject-permissions-work) regarding metafields access simplification, we are now implementing the removal of `PUBLIC` access for app-owned metafields and metaobjects.

alerts.summary: The draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout mutation is deprecated; migrate to draftOrderComplete after reviewing its inputs, outputs, and behavior.
alerts.quote: As of API version 2025-07, the `draftOrderCreateMerchantCheckout` mutation has been deprecated.

alerts.summary: POS cash payments and refunds in the listed currencies and regions now round automatically; include cash rounding adjustments when calculating actual payment, refund, and transaction totals using the fields available in API versions 2024-10 and later.
alerts.quote: For specific currencies, cash transactions on Point of Sale now automatically round to the nearest denomination.

alerts.summary: After August 1, 2025, Order.statusPageUrl defaults to capability-token URLs with limited uses, expiration, and longer URLs; review URL storage and delivery assumptions and specify notification_usage and audience for the intended use case.
alerts.quote: After August 1, 2025, all URLs will default to using tokens configured for web customer view.

alerts.summary: Updating a suspended product with productSet now returns PRODUCT_SUSPENDED instead of INVALID_PRODUCT; update error handling for this case.
alerts.quote: As of the `2025-07` version of the GraphQL Admin API, an attempt to update a suspended product using `productSet` mutation will now return [`PRODUCT_SUSPENDED`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/enums/ProductSetUserErrorCode#enum-PRODUCT_SUSPENDED) error code instead of [`INVALID_PRODUCT`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-07/enums/ProductSetUserErrorCode#enum-INVALID_PRODUCT).

alerts.summary: A line item's quantity can now be split across multiple fulfillment locations, so GraphQL and REST integrations must account for all fulfillment orders for an inventory item rather than assuming there is only one.
alerts.quote: Now, a line item can be allocated to multiple fulfillment locations.

alerts.summary: Stable Admin GraphQL API enums are becoming non-exhaustive, which can disrupt tooling and exhaustive enum handling; refresh introspection caches periodically and add catch-all handling for unknown values.
alerts.quote: Our stable API versions will retroactively add values into GraphQL Enum types, making them non-exhaustive going forward.

alerts.summary: Stable Storefront GraphQL API enums are becoming non-exhaustive, which can disrupt tooling and exhaustive enum handling; refresh introspection caches periodically and add catch-all handling for unknown values.
alerts.quote: Our stable API versions will retroactively add values into GraphQL Enum types, making them non-exhaustive going forward.

alerts.summary: Starting April 1, 2026, draft orders created on or after April 1, 2025 can be automatically purged after one year of inactivity; handle missing draft orders and preserve any data your app needs before deletion.
alerts.quote: Automatic removal of inactive draft orders will begin on April 1, 2026.

alerts.summary: Retail exchanges now consolidate Return and Order Edit sales into one Return agreement, so update integrations that expect separate sales agreements.
alerts.quote: * Separate sales agreements for the Return and the Order Edit are no longer created. The Return agreement now includes all the sales created from an exchange.

alerts.summary: Shopify POS exchanges now enforce Return-platform exchange validations and constraints, so review workflows that relied on the previous retail exchange behaviour.
alerts.quote: * The same validations and constraints that apply to exchanges on the Return platform also apply to exchanges conducted through Shopify POS.

alerts.summary: Order.exchangeV2s now includes exchanges created in Admin or through returnCreate, so use the include_mirrored_exchanges query filter if your integration must exclude them.
alerts.quote: Furthermore, exchanges created in Admin, or via the `returnCreate()` APIs will now be visible on the `Order.exchangeV2s()` API.

alerts.summary: ExchangeV2 APIs are deprecated and planned for removal after a one-year deprecation period, so migrate integrations to the Shopify Exchange Platform.
alerts.quote: We are [deprecating](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/pos/exchangesv2deprecation) the ExchangeV2 APIs and plan to remove them after a 1-year deprecation period.

alerts.summary: FeeSale.fee can return null for a deleted fee starting in 2025-07; update consumers to handle null before accessing fee data.
alerts.quote: As of 2025-07, the `FeeSale.fee` field is now nullable, meaning a `Fee` can be null if it has been deleted.

alerts.summary: Storefront Checkout mutations stop working on April 1, 2025; migrate affected apps to the Storefront Cart API before that date.
alerts.quote: Customers will not be able to create or complete checkouts using the deprecated Checkout APIs after the deadline.

alerts.summary: REST Admin Checkout endpoints stop working on April 1, 2025; migrate affected apps to the Storefront Cart API before that date.
alerts.quote: Customers will not be able to create or complete checkouts using the deprecated Checkout APIs after the deadline.

alerts.summary: The `X-Shopify-API-Deprecated-Reason` response header now contains a list of detected GraphQL deprecations rather than a URL; update code that parses or assumes a URL in this header.
alerts.quote: As of `2025-04`, the `X-Shopify-API-Deprecated-Reason` HTTP header will return the list of detected deprecations instead of a generic URL.

alerts.summary: New metafield and metaobject definitions can no longer use namespaces or types containing `--`; update creation code and configuration to avoid that sequence, while leaving existing definitions unchanged.
alerts.quote: You can no longer make any metafield namespace or metaobject type that includes `--` (e.g., `foo--` , `foo--bar` ).

alerts.summary: The entry lists the Customer Account API as affected by the restriction on new metafield namespaces and metaobject types containing `--`; avoid that sequence when creating new definitions, while leaving existing definitions unchanged.
alerts.quote: You can no longer make any metafield namespace or metaobject type that includes `--` (e.g., `foo--` , `foo--bar` ).

alerts.summary: Updating metafields or metaobjects with unchanged values no longer triggers webhooks or related actions; adjust integrations that rely on these no-op updates to trigger processing.
alerts.quote: Starting today, when updating metafields and metaobjects, we'll skip triggering webhooks and related actions if the new value matches the existing one.

alerts.summary: A catalog can now belong to multiple markets, so update code consuming MarketCatalog.markets to handle multiple entries rather than assuming a single market.
alerts.quote: Consequently, the [`MarketCatalog.markets`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketCatalog#connection-markets) connection will no longer guarantee the return of a single entry.

alerts.summary: Markets can now include company-location conditions, so add type: REGION to QueryRoot.markets queries that must retain region-only behavior.
alerts.quote: To maintain the existing behavior and access only `Regions`, you must update the `markets` connection by using the `type: REGION` argument.

alerts.summary: Payout API responses merge In Transit into Scheduled; update status handling to recognize Scheduled for both previous states.
alerts.quote: * **Merged Payout Statuses:** The previous statuses of "In Transit" and "Scheduled" will now be represented simply as **Scheduled**.

alerts.summary: Continuous cart authentication changes authenticated checkout handling: request Cart.checkoutUrl when the buyer is ready to check out, supply customerAccessToken in the cart buyer identity, and include the buyer IP address in server-side requests.
alerts.quote: Note that for security reasons, the checkoutUrl should be requested when the customer is ready to navigate to checkout, which can be re-requested if needed.

alerts.summary: Admin GraphQL API callers using localizationExtensions should migrate to localizedFields after verifying the affected parent types, arguments, and return types.
alerts.quote: The localizationExtensions field in the Admin GraphQL API has now been renamed to localizedFields too.

alerts.summary: Primary-market region workflows must migrate to the shop-wide backup-region model using backupRegionUpdate and BackupRegionUpdateInput.
alerts.quote: Instead of `MarketRegionCreateInput`, you must use [`BackupRegionUpdateInput`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/input-objects/BackupRegionUpdateInput).

alerts.summary: Market.currencySettings can now be null when settings are inherited from the parent market, so callers must handle null instead of assuming settings are always present.
alerts.quote: The [`Market.currencySettings`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/Market#field-currencysettings) field is now nullable.

alerts.summary: Web presences can have zero or multiple markets, so callers must handle an absent singular market and migrate deprecated MarketWebPresence.market usage to the markets connection.
alerts.quote: The field [`MarketWebPresence.market`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#field-market) is deprecated in favour of [`MarketWebPresence.markets`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-04/objects/MarketWebPresence#connection-markets), which allows for this expanded functionality.

alerts.summary: Product and product-variant contextual pricing no longer considers draft markets, so callers must update pricing expectations and ensure markets intended to affect prices are active.
alerts.quote: As of `2025-04`, the Product's [contextualPricing](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/Product#field-contextualpricing) field and Product Variant's [contextualPricing](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2025-01/objects/ProductVariant#field-contextualpricing) field will resolve prices only considering active markets.

alerts.summary: New apps submitted to the Shopify App Store starting January 6, 2025 must use the new GraphQL Product APIs; migrate away from deprecated REST product resources to qualify for approval.
